kind: derived assistant visual review, not an original GitHub artifact and not a human interaction test
method: Opened all sixteen assigned PNGs individually with tools.view_image; each original hash and size independently matched the authenticated GUI receipt. No image was edited, resized, cropped or recomposed.

summary.scope: Only the visible states of these sixteen screenshots. Scroll boundaries and intentionally truncated long paths are recorded separately from fixed-header clipping.

limits: No clicks, keyboard operation, scrolling, resizing or animations were exercised.
No human VoiceOver audit was performed.
Visible OCR recognition errors remain; this review does not establish transcription accuracy.
This derived report does not itself approve installation, runtime isolation, every tool, external service delivery, M4 performance or AI generation.
No independent inspection of all seventy-one tool cards is claimed from the home/list screenshots.

limits: Não demonstra os demais itens da lista nem navegação, favoritos ou recuperação por interação.
